caption: How hi data works. On a machine connected to your team's hi server, hi data get asks the server for a hi data token for one repository, for a day, and runs the official hf tool pointed at the server with that token. The server passes on only calls that read what your group may read, swaps in the team's Hugging Face token, and records who downloaded what. File contents come straight from Hugging Face's storage to your machine, so the server never sees them, and no Hugging Face token is ever on your machine.

items.title: hi data get
items.does: Gets a hi data token from the server that works only for this download, from this machine.

items.title: hf download
items.does: Pointed at your server, with the hi data token instead of a Hugging Face one.

items.title: ./data/bars-1d
items.does: Straight from Hugging Face's storage; large files never pass through the server.

items.title: hi server data
items.does: Passes on only reads of what your group may read, swaps in the team's token, and records who downloaded what.

items.title: huggingface.co
items.does: Answers the API through the server, and sends the files themselves straight to your machine.
